DeliveryAddress.title: DeliveryAddress
DeliveryAddress.description: A saved user delivery address for medicine orders.

label.description: Short address label such as Home or Work.

fullAddress.description: Complete street, apartment, and locality address.

contactPhone.description: Recipient phone number for delivery coordination.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default selected delivery address.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

CartItem.title: CartItem
CartItem.description: A medicine line item in the user's active pharmacy cart.

storeId.description: Identifier of the fulfilling medical store.

storeName.description: Display name of the fulfilling medical store.

unitPrice.description: Unit price at the selected medical store.

requiresPrescription.description: Whether a valid prescription image is required at checkout.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

FavoriteStore.title: FavoriteStore
FavoriteStore.description: A user's saved favorite Kochi medical store.

storeId.description: Identifier of the favorited Kochi medical store.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

MedicineOrder.title: MedicineOrder
MedicineOrder.description: A placed medicine delivery order fulfilled by a medical store.

storeId.description: Identifier of the fulfilling medical store.

storeName.description: Display name of the fulfilling medical store.

itemsSummary.description: Human-readable summary of ordered medicines and quantities.

itemsPayload.description: Compact medicineId:quantity pairs separated by semicolons for deterministic 1-tap reorder.

itemCount.description: Total unit count in the order.

subtotal.description: Medicine subtotal before delivery fee, coupon, and tip.

deliveryFee.description: Courier delivery fee charged after promo adjustments.

discountAmount.description: Promo coupon discount applied to the order.

couponCode.description: Applied promo coupon code (empty if none).

tipAmount.description: Optional tip added for the delivery partner.

deliveryAddress.description: Snapshot of the delivery destination address.

deliveryInstructions.description: Customer drop-off instructions for store and rider.

hasPrescription.description: Whether a prescription image was attached via Photo Picker.

prescriptionFileName.description: Display label of attached prescription media.

estimatedMinutes.description: Estimated doorstep delivery duration in minutes.

rating.description: Customer post-delivery rating (0 if unrated, 1-5 after rating).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

LiveOrderTracking.title: LiveOrderTracking
LiveOrderTracking.description: Real-time Google Maps GPS telemetry and assigned delivery partner metadata for an order.

storeId.description: Identifier of the fulfilling Kochi medical store.

storeName.description: Display name of the fulfilling Kochi medical store.

partnerVehicle.description: Assigned delivery partner vehicle registration and type.

status.description: Current order lifecycle status synchronized with tracking.

progressFraction.description: Normalized transit completion fraction from 0.0 to 1.0.

partnerLat.description: Live GPS latitude of the delivery partner.

partnerLng.description: Live GPS longitude of the delivery partner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on GPS update.

/users/{userId}/addresses/{addressId}.description: Per-user saved delivery addresses isolated by userId.

/users/{userId}/cartItems/{cartItemId}.description: Per-user active pharmacy cart items isolated by userId.

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Per-user medicine delivery orders isolated by userId.

/users/{userId}/tracking/{orderId}.description: Per-user real-time Google Maps rider GPS coordinates isolated by userId.
